people.line: A city in the north, site of Aramean battles.

people.name: Ben-hadad
people.line: King of Aram, contemporary of Asa and Baasha.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Syria

translations.web: At the return of the year, Ben Hadad mustered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.
translations.bsb: In the spring, Ben-hadad mobilized the Arameans and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.
